description.fun: Tapu Koko is the guardian deity of Melemele Island: it protects its home but is fickle, and won't necessarily help people in need. It's curious, though, and drops in to play or battle with anyone who interests it, and it has an explosive temper that it forgets as soon as it cools down. It charges up by summoning thunderclouds and shutting itself inside the rooster-like shells on its arms.
description.guide: Tapu Koko is an Electric- and Fairy-type Legendary Pokémon, the guardian deity of Melemele Island in Alola. It is one of the four tapu, each guarding one island. Its design draws on a rooster and tiki statues, and possibly the Hawaiian war god Kūkaʻilimoku.
description.tagline: Melemele's fickle thunderbird guardian, curious and quick-tempered
